name: My First Car Bot
tagline: Keeps a first car legal, serviced and understood
description: Tracks the dates a new owner tends to lose: maintenance intervals, registration renewals, inspections and insurance, all visible in one list. When a shop hands over a quote, it explains the line items in plain words so you can tell necessary work from optional. It also covers moving a car to a different state.
author: gilman_trevor
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
